title: A brief worth building
summary: Interface concept informed by CraftsmanAI: a focused material-selection step.
problem: A custom jewelry request needs enough detail to begin without overwhelming the customer.
decisions: Divide the brief into named steps with a visible current position.
Use material swatches beside plain-language labels.
Keep the product starting point beside editable choices.
interaction: Select a material, then continue to the next step.
nextTest: Test whether a first-time requester can choose materials without explanation.

title: Decisions beside the design
summary: Interface concept informed by CraftsmanAI: an approval room with anchored feedback.
problem: Design feedback becomes difficult to act on when comments are separated from the visual.
decisions: Anchor comments to numbered points on the design.
Place the design response directly beneath each request.
Separate reviewing a direction from final product approval.
interaction: Select an annotation to reveal its feedback and the next decision.
nextTest: Observe whether reviewers can explain what changed before approving.

title: The estimate, explained
summary: Interface concept informed by CraftsmanAI Metrix: a transparent cost review.
problem: A jeweler needs to inspect estimate assumptions before preparing a customer quote.
decisions: Separate cost lines from the pricing adjustment.
Label illustrative values as estimates.
Make assumptions accessible beside each component.
interaction: Review cost components, adjust pricing and prepare a quote.
nextTest: Ask a jeweler to identify an uncertain cost and revise its assumption.

title: Objects of attention
summary: Interface concept informed by GemShot: an editorial jewelry catalog workspace.
problem: A catalog should make individual pieces easy to scan without burying them in administration.
decisions: Prioritize product imagery above interface chrome.
Keep identifiers consistent across the collection.
Expose an add action without disrupting the contact sheet.
interaction: Open a piece from the contact sheet and inspect its details.
nextTest: Check whether catalog users can locate a specific piece from visual cues.

title: Start with the need
summary: Interface concept informed by CareThread: a progressive support-needs intake.
problem: A care coordinator needs a clear request without collecting unnecessary information upfront.
decisions: Lead with support needs before administrative details.
Use persistent selection feedback beyond color alone.
Keep the next step and save action explicit.
interaction: Choose support needs, retain selections and continue to documents.
nextTest: Test whether coordinators can complete the need selection using only a keyboard.

title: A handoff you can follow
summary: Interface concept informed by CareThread: document readiness as a timeline.
problem: A case can stall when a missing document is hidden among completed tasks.
decisions: Arrange readiness as an ordered sequence.
Use status words beside completion markers.
Make the open item visually prominent without hiding completed context.
interaction: Inspect an open requirement and move to its document action.
nextTest: Ask a reviewer to identify the next required action without opening every step.

title: A useful packet
summary: Interface concept informed by CareThread: assembling a reviewable referral packet.
problem: A handoff document needs a clear preview and intentional information inclusion.
decisions: Separate included sections, document preview and export checks.
Keep consent and destination checks beside export.
Use a document-like hierarchy instead of a generic dashboard.
interaction: Include a section, preview the packet and review export readiness.
nextTest: Test whether users can remove unnecessary information before export.

title: Review with context
summary: Interface concept informed by CareThread: a supervisor decision workspace.
problem: A supervisor needs the review queue and relevant evidence in the same place.
decisions: Keep the queue visible while inspecting a case.
Summarize readiness before the review note.
Give approve and request-changes distinct actions.
interaction: Select a sample case, add a review note and choose a decision.
nextTest: Check whether reviewers understand the consequence of each decision.

title: Know what is coming
summary: Interface concept informed by RevCue: a creator revenue overview.
problem: A creator needs to distinguish expected income from a confirmed payout.
decisions: Use explicit expected and confirmation labels.
Group revenue by source rather than decorative metrics.
Give the next payout a separate place in the hierarchy.
interaction: Inspect an income source and review the payout status.
nextTest: Ask creators to distinguish an estimate from money ready to withdraw.

title: Follow the decision
summary: Interface concept informed by AeroTrace: a flight decision replay surface.
problem: A replay must explain why a route changed while preserving spatial and event context.
decisions: Connect the selected timeline event to its location.
Place the explanation beside the map.
Keep playback controls independent from inspection.
interaction: Select an event, inspect the decision and move through the replay.
nextTest: Check whether a reviewer can connect a route change to its recorded evidence.

title: Find the reason
summary: An exception-matching interface study for financial operations.
problem: A reviewer needs to compare records before confirming a match.
decisions: Show both records at equal visual weight.
Align comparable fields across the split view.
Keep the action specific to the records under inspection.
interaction: Select an exception, compare record fields and confirm a sample match.
nextTest: Test whether reviewers notice a mismatched field before confirmation.

title: A pause with context
summary: An execution-inspection study for a human-reviewed AI workflow.
problem: A paused workflow is hard to resume safely when its state and evidence are unclear.
decisions: Show the path, checkpoint and references in one view.
Use explicit state names rather than a generic loading indicator.
Require a visible decision before resuming.
interaction: Inspect the checkpoint, review references and record a resume decision.
nextTest: Ask an operator to explain what will happen after resume.

title: Small steps. Ready store.
summary: A mobile onboarding concept for an independent merchant.
problem: A new merchant needs a useful starting point before configuration becomes a burden.
decisions: Ask one essential question on each screen.
Make progress visible without emphasizing a long checklist.
Explain which decisions can be changed later.
interaction: Name the store and continue while preserving the draft.
nextTest: Observe where a first-time merchant hesitates during the first setup step.

title: Keyboard first
summary: A command-palette interaction and focus-state study.
problem: Frequent actions should remain quick to reach without crowding the permanent navigation.
decisions: Use a single search field for navigation and actions.
Show keyboard hints at the point of use.
Keep the selected result distinct from background content.
interaction: Open the palette, move with arrow keys and select a command.
nextTest: Verify focus return and escape behavior with keyboard-only participants.

title: A system for clarity
summary: A typography study in scale, spacing, labels and reading rhythm.
problem: A visual hierarchy needs to remain clear across expressive headlines and practical interface copy.
decisions: Use a strong display scale with compact tracking.
Separate semantic text roles before choosing sizes.
Give labels a consistent monospace rhythm.
interaction: Compare display, heading, body and label roles as one system.
nextTest: Check actual reading comfort at narrow and wide viewport widths.

title: Don’t make people guess
summary: A form-state concept with explicit errors, visible focus and completion feedback.
problem: A form must explain errors and success without depending only on color.
decisions: Keep field labels visible after typing.
Describe how to correct an invalid entry.
Show a clear keyboard focus ring and written success feedback.
interaction: Enter an invalid address, correct it and save a preference.
nextTest: Verify keyboard order, screen-reader error association and color contrast.

title: Three moments of clarity
summary: A mobile delivery-handoff journey concept.
problem: A courier needs an obvious next action at pickup, confirmation and completion.
decisions: Give each moment one primary action.
Present a checklist at the point of collection.
Use an explicit recorded state before moving to the next stop.
interaction: Open a pickup, confirm its checklist and review the recorded handoff.
nextTest: Test whether the three stages remain understandable without prior training.

title: Start with the evidence
summary: A knowledge-search concept that keeps source context beside a result.
problem: A useful search result should be easy to verify against its supporting source.
decisions: Keep the query visible while reading results.
Separate the excerpt from its source context.
Make opening a reference a direct action.
interaction: Search a sample question and inspect the supporting reference.
nextTest: Check whether readers can distinguish an excerpt from a synthesized answer.

title: Useful at every state
summary: A component study for empty content, recoverable errors and zero-result searches.
problem: An empty or interrupted screen should still help the person move forward.
decisions: Explain the specific state in plain language.
Pair each state with a relevant recovery action.
Use illustrations to support the message without replacing it.
interaction: Create a first item, retry an interrupted action or clear search filters.
nextTest: Ask users to choose a next action for each state without prompting.

title: Motion with a purpose
summary: An interaction-preference concept with a complete reduced-motion alternative.
problem: Expressive motion needs an equally usable experience when movement is reduced.
decisions: Make movement preferences visible and reversible.
Treat immediate transitions as a complete interaction state.
Keep optional sound off until intentionally enabled.
interaction: Change motion preferences and preview the resulting transition.
nextTest: Verify system reduced-motion preference, saved choices and immediate feedback.
